_about: Trigger cases for the SKILL.md description and mr.trigger.classify. `fire` is whether the skill should expand the message; `seed` is the text left after removing the invocation phrase. A seed is about the skill only when it names mind-reading next to one of its parts, or names grants.md, corrections.md, the always-on block or the reading tags; 'the model', 'the skill', 'SKILL.md' and 'index.json' alone are ordinary seed words.
